weights_explained: 规则采用确定性优先级，非机器学习推荐分数；按内容和素材条件选择。
priority: 用户明确指定风格或标题及画幅
明确有用户截图且需要以其为基础时，先锁定截图中的真实主体/事件，使用跨平台截图工作流
真实素材可用性及用户肖像要求
内容目标和可验证证据
模型能力与实际导出限制

content_routes.when: 首发宣传、剧情向、角色氛围
主播出镜、实况、游戏反应
content_routes.require: 未上传主播肖像则默认无真人虚构主播；可用原创虚构插画人物但不冒充主播
要求用户提供可验证的画面证据时才将异常描述为真实

content_routes.when: 对比、GTA5 vs GTA6、游戏 vs 现实
content_routes.require: 需有两方素材才称为真实对比；否则标示为概念示意

content_routes.when: 新闻资讯、版本盘点、性能评测
content_routes.require: 用户必须提供核实的数字与主张，未知则不编造

content_routes.when: 小成本、纯游戏画面、动作创意

content_routes.require: 仅用户明确直播或给出集数时添加LIVE/EP标签

composition_rules: 始终先定画幅，再定主视觉安全区，最后确定文字位置。
优先一个主焦点；角色出镜时应形成主次清晰的双主体，不允许主角群像互相抢戏。
标题语言按用户输入，YouTube不等于只能英文；跨平台适配优先换画幅和视觉层次，不自动翻译。
文字标题只在用户没给定标题时自动创作；已给定则不擅自改写。
不混入源截图中的播放量、时长、UI按键、平台水印与账号昵称。
不要把训练参考图整张当作可复用素材或逐像素复刻他人封面。
不同尺寸裁切需重新排布而非压缩拉伸；优先 preserving hero subject / text / highlighted evidence.
生成工具不支持目标像素或可控文字时，诚实报告限制；有文字叠加能力时图像和文字分层完成。

output_contract.when_image_tool_available: 直接生成目标画幅图片；给出平台、比例、已核实的实际尺寸和简短修改提示
output_contract.when_image_tool_missing: 返回一条可直接用于可用生图工具的完整提示词，不声称已出图
output_contract.multi_platform: 按画幅逐张重新构图，不得仅把横图裁成竖图

first_match_rules.then: minimal_action_or_gameplay_question; do not invent a real streamer
gameplay_question; label as idea not proven

deterministic_selector.preflight: clarification_rules.json -> decision_catalog.json -> design_brief_schema.json; then original style/layout/typography selector

modification_dispatch: Follow references/editing_rules.json when request refers to previous output; preserve locked fields unless user explicitly overrides.
capability_dispatch: Before any export claim, apply references/capabilities.json and verify tool supports required output.
invalid_assumptions: 每张参考图都获授权可再分发
只要装Skill就自动有生图工具

preflight_dispatch.before_style_selector: Run references/clarification_rules.json. Select one of GENERATE_NOW, RECOMMEND_AND_ASK, SUGGEST_AND_GENERATE, EDIT_EXISTING, SAFE_FALLBACK.
preflight_dispatch.user_choice_to_brief: Merge the chosen option with known slots via references/design_brief_schema.json; do not ask for values already known.
preflight_dispatch.review_subtype_lookup: references/decision_catalog.json review_subtypes. Do not map all review prompts to generic cinematic_poster.
preflight_dispatch.skip_question_safeguard: For direct generation/just do it, no questions. Use a neutral, non-factual review hook if specific verdict unknown.
hard_rules: Explicit user heading wins over proposed title
At most one question per turn and two turns total
No second question after user has selected a concrete creative direction
preflight_dispatch.screenshot_first: 用户已上传截图、已有标题和平台：直接基于源图二次包装，不要先追问或把电影感解读为实体海报。

screenshot_mode_dispatch.trigger: when accessible user screenshot exists and the request asks to use/redesign/preserve that screenshot
screenshot_mode_dispatch.cinematic_poster_override: film-look full-bleed video thumbnail, no physical poster frame
screenshot_mode_dispatch.do_not_ask_if: source image + platform + exact title + desired visual style provided
screenshot_mode_dispatch.fallback: if uploaded image is unavailable, acknowledge and ask for attachment only when strict preservation required; otherwise offer concept image
screenshot_mode_dispatch.text_priority: exact user title overrides any autogenerated platform tagline

v16_visual_contract_dispatch.priority: over vague style adjectives, below explicit user constraints
v16_visual_contract_dispatch.platform_preset: use output.default unless explicit user requests other preset; Bilibili creative main is 16:9
v16_visual_contract_dispatch.layout_id: pick using platform.layout_selection[content_type], then adapt using source screenshot negative space
v16_visual_contract_dispatch.quality_check: global H1-H8; if fail attempt bounded repair and disclose limitations
